messages.subject: Project Granite — draft Heads of Terms
messages.plaintextBody:
Jonathan,

Following our call, I attach a first draft of the Heads of Terms for the acquisition of the entire share capital of Calder Vale Foods. The key commercial points are an enterprise value of £45m on a cash-free, debt-free basis, a 5% retention held for 18 months, and exclusivity through to 19 December.

Grateful for your comments. We have kept everything subject to contract save for the usual binding provisions.

Best,

James Osei
Senior Associate
Whitfield Carter LLP

messages.subject: RE: Project Granite — draft Heads of Terms
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Thank you. The Sellers are broadly comfortable. Two points: they would like exclusivity limited to eight weeks rather than open-ended, and they want it made clear the retention is the buyer's sole recourse for warranty claims up to its amount. Otherwise the structure works.

Can we aim to sign the Heads by Friday?

Regards,

Jonathan Vane
Partner
Castle & Vane LLP
